final_claim: For each m>=2 and conjugation-invariant E subset of mu_m\{1}, a strictly positive rank-one coupling of the unilateral shift and m-cycle on ell_1 has point spectrum exactly E, spectrum closed disk, essential and approximate spectra unit circle, exact Fourier-codimension |E| strata and linear power-norm growth.
limitations: Positive couplings are not power bounded; full peripheral spectrum remains the circle, so no contradiction of universal cyclicity.
Only a reducible rank-one family on ell_1; does not cover all positive operators.
